answer: An ivory ceiling on identity issuance, where each agent must post a costly bond that is slashed if its attested provenance fails, makes honest registration the dominant strategy. At the summit of the design, a staked reputation registry lets agents vouch under collateral, so a sybil cluster must lock real capital per fake identity and forfeits it on detection. The meadow of honest agents then thrives because forging N identities costs N bonds plus reputational loss, though colluding whales who can absorb slashing remain the limit.
